Backward compatibility: dual-subscribe old + new patterns during migration with deprecation warning.\n230\t\n231\t---\n232\t\n233\t### Finding H-18: GDPR Cross-Service Erasure Orchestrator\n234\t\n235\t**Complexity:** HIGH\n236\t**Dependencies:** M-15 (tenant-scoped subjects improve event routing)\n237\t**Estimated time:** 8 hours\n238\t\n239\t#### Current State\n240\t\n241\tMessaging-service has comprehensive GDPR erasure. Auth-service has consent management + partial user lifecycle deletion. No GDPR erasure for: farm, hr, billing, sensor, hydroponics services.\n242\t\n243\t#### Files to Modify\n244\t\n245\t1. `libs/event-contracts/src/gdpr/gdpr-events.ts` (NEW) -- Define GDPR event contracts: `GdprErasureRequested`, `GdprErasureCompleted`, `GdprErasureFailed`\n246\t2. `libs/backend-common/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.interface.ts` (NEW) -- Define `GdprErasureHandler` interface that each service implements\n247\t3. `apps/admin-api-service/src/security/services/compliance.service.ts` -- Add erasure orchestration endpoint that emits `GdprErasureRequested` event\n248\t4. `apps/auth-service/src/modules/gdpr/services/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Handle user data anonymization in auth schema\n249\t5. `apps/farm-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize farm data (ownership records, notes, comments)\n250\t6. `apps/hr-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize HR records (employee PII)\n251\t7. `apps/billing-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize billing data (retain financial records with anonymized PII per legal retention requirements)\n252\t8. `apps/sensor-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize operator assignments on devices\n253\t9. `apps/hydroponics-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize operator references\n254\t\n255\t#### Implementation Approach\n256\t\n257\t1. **Saga pattern**: Orchestrator emits `GdprErasureRequested` with `{ userId, tenantId, requestedBy, legalBasis }`.\n258\t2. Each service listens, replaces PII with `REDACTED-{hash(userId)}`, retains non-PII, emits `GdprErasureCompleted` or `GdprErasureFailed`.\n259\t3. Orchestrator tracks per-service completion; marks complete only when ALL services report success.\n260\t4. Legal hold check before erasure (extend messaging-service pattern to orchestrator).\n261\t5. Each action audit-logged via `AuditLogModule` with legal basis and timestamp.\n262\t\n263\t---\n264\t\n265\t### Finding M-10: Per-Service PostgreSQL Connection Strings\n266\t\n267\t**Complexity:** MEDIUM\n268\t**Dependencies:** None (init-scripts already create per-service roles)\n269\t**Estimated time:** 3 hours"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8b2384a0-ddac-4afe-9511-cb39acb3227e","uuid":"fb936053-3b93-4187-8096-5fc1dd92e5f6","timestamp":"2026-10-09T18:31:44.493Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/home/gharunner/actions-runner/_work/aquaculture_platform/aquaculture_platform/aria-worktrees/req-AIR-aria-consensus-arbiter-d758820ff715/docs/plans/2026-04-01-security-remediation-remaining.md","content":"\n1. No GDPR erasure for: farm, hr, billing, sensor, hydroponics services.\n\n#### Files to Modify\n\n1. `libs/event-contracts/src/gdpr/gdpr-events.ts` (NEW) -- Define GDPR event contracts: `GdprErasureRequested`, `GdprErasureCompleted`, `GdprErasureFailed`\n2. `libs/backend-common/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.interface.ts` (NEW) -- Define `GdprErasureHandler` interface that each service implements\n3. `apps/admin-api-service/src/security/services/compliance.service.ts` -- Add erasure orchestration endpoint that emits `GdprErasureRequested` event\n4. `apps/auth-service/src/modules/gdpr/services/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Handle user data anonymization in auth schema\n5. `apps/farm-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize farm data (ownership records, notes, comments)\n6. `apps/hr-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize HR records (employee PII)\n7. `apps/billing-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize billing data (retain financial records with anonymized PII per legal retention requirements)\n8. `apps/sensor-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize operator assignments on devices\n9. `apps/hydroponics-service/src/gdpr/gdpr-erasure.handler.ts` (NEW) -- Anonymize operator references\n\n#### Implementation Approach\n\n1. **Saga pattern**: Orchestrator emits `GdprErasureRequested` with `{ userId, tenantId, requestedBy, legalBasis }`.\n2.
